datePolicy: Drive dates are upload metadata, not original creation or version chronology. Top-level sourceDate is deliberately unset for this batch.
identityPolicy: Same-title games are compared using campaign, characters, controls, content and provenance. No filename-only identity claims. Bean Napped and Cloverhollow replace the same campaigns at their existing destinations. Meridian exports retain independent IDs because no successor lineage is established.
